verdict.rationale: Khoj is itself a built-in AI assistant, and its own docs show users can hand it work. It chats over the user's files and the web, runs scheduled automations that email research results, offers custom agents with their own persona, knowledge and tools, and generates and runs Python for data analysis and reports. Community comments on local-model performance and early OpenAI dependence concern model quality, not whether delegation works, so they do not create a dispute. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of task delegation (automations, agents, code execution) beyond vendor docs.
